name: rsilo
description: RSilo - RemoteStorage server for Cloudflare Workers + R2 + D1

ACCOUNT_USERNAME.description: Your storage username, e.g. `jono`: lowercase letters, digits, `.`, `_` or `-`. Apps connect as `<username>@<your Worker's host>`. Keep it once chosen.

OWNER_EMAIL.description: Your email address. Only this email may open `/account`; it must match the email you allow in the Cloudflare Access policy (see the README, **Set up Cloudflare Access**).

PUBLIC_BASE_URL.description: Your Worker's address: `https://<worker-name>.<your-subdomain>.workers.dev` (your subdomain is shown under **Workers & Pages** in the dashboard). Origin only, no path. Until it is set, `/account` shows a **finish setup** page.
